rules.text: Buy names that enter the top 40 when a slot is free.
Sell a holding only after its rank falls past 80 (top 40 × buffer). Oscillation around 40 is ignored.
Keep holdings ranked 41–80. The buffer exists to cut turnover and STCG.
A new buy needs positive 12–1 / 6–1 momentum.
Entry-zone names wait if every current holding is still inside the buffer.

note: Decision support only — no orders are placed. Execute manually.
